0022600124.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (3-0, 2-0 at home, 1st in the Northwest, 2nd in the West) host the Phoenix Suns (1-1, 1-0 at home, 8th in the West, 1.5 games back in the Pacific) in the fourth game of the Thunder's season. Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-2 and swept the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, most recently beating the Suns 131-122 in Phoenix.
